words.example: I will join the webinar from the huddle room so the office stays quiet.
words.exampleZh: 我到小讨论室参加网络研讨会，免得办公室不安静。

words.example: The conference call dropped once, and we dialed straight back.
words.exampleZh: 电话会议中断了一次，我们马上又拨了回去。

words.example: The dial-in is printed on the invitation, just under the link.
words.exampleZh: 拨入号印在邀请上，就在链接下面。

words.example: Please mute the speaker when you walk past the open wards.
words.exampleZh: 经过敞开的病区时，请把免提静音。

words.example: Unmute one person at a time so each speaker can be heard.
words.exampleZh: 一次只取消一个人的静音，这样发言的人才能被听清。

words.meaning: 疾病分类编码（International Classification of Diseases, 10th Revision）
words.example: ICD-10 (International Classification of Diseases, 10th Revision) on this discharge is still blank.
words.exampleZh: 这份出院记录上的ICD-10（疾病分类编码）还是空的。

words.meaning: 临床术语标准（Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine）
words.example: SNOMED (Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine) has no match for this local diagnosis name.
words.exampleZh: SNOMED（临床术语标准）对不上这个本院诊断名称。

words.meaning: 检验指标编码（Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes）
words.example: LOINC (Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes) is missing on two chemistry results.
words.exampleZh: 两条生化结果上缺少LOINC（检验指标编码）。

words.example: CPT (Current Procedural Terminology) for this procedure does not match the charge.
words.exampleZh: 这项操作的CPT（操作编码）和收费对不上。

words.meaning: 疾病相关分组（Diagnosis Related Group）
words.example: DRG (Diagnosis Related Group) changed after coding added the complication.
words.exampleZh: 编码补上并发症之后，DRG（疾病相关分组）变了。
